posts.text: @Shripad Reason for divergence could be a variety of reasons. I dont make it a point to try and decipher each and every thing about a business I own. It’s a good thing to know most things about the business you own, or intend to own, but beyond a point too much digging is also counter productive. For me, the commentary in last couple of concalls, and the actual numbers reported assume a lot of significance.
